# Identity

Control events that link an anonymous visitor to a customer. Never delivered to providers.

[All domains](README.md)

## `identify`

Links the current anonymous visitor to a customer id. Recorded as an identity link; past events are not rewritten.

**Sources:** browser, server · **Version:** 1 · **Control event:** not delivered to providers

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity.userId` | string | yes |  |

```json
{
  "identity": {
    "userId": "customer_123"
  }
}
```
